title: UN Commission finding on attacks at civilian locations
summary: The Commission examined attacks at civilian communities and other civilian locations on 7 October.
claim: The Commission found that members of Palestinian armed groups deliberately killed, injured, mistreated and took hostages among civilians at locations in southern Israel on 7 October 2023.
legal_characterization: Factual finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment or individual conviction.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the cited paragraphs of A/HRC/56/26 and the Commission methodology in paragraphs 3-7, including its reasonable-grounds standard. This is attributed to the Commission and is not a court judgment or an individual conviction.
